en: Multi-view black‑and‑white postcard showing different scenes of an outdoor municipal swimming pool complex with lawns and trees. One central image features a decorative frog fountain sculpture. Other panels depict children playing in shallow water, people sunbathing on the grass next to the pool, and general views of the pool basins, ladders, and surrounding park-like grounds. The caption at the bottom reads "Stadtbad Meißen."
